name: Animated Wallpaper
author: r4venward
description: Play a video as your desktop wallpaper, per monitor, through mpvpaper — with a bar toggle and a panel to pick and control the videos.

barWidget.description: Video wallpapers per monitor: toggle from the bar, pick videos in the panel.

schema.label: Show next to the icon
schema.description: Nothing keeps the bar quiet with just the icon. Active monitors shows how many screens currently have a wallpaper playing, as active/total.
